about_the_game:
HorrorVale: Act M is a Side Story taking place in the HorrorVale universe. 

Join Mothman and his very own Cryptid Crew as he travels through the valley of HorrorVale to fend off Creepies, Scaries, and of course his own rival Webs McGregor. 

HorrorVale: Act M is a traditional turn based RPG taking place in a spooky, halloween themed world. 

Gameplay

  • The turn based Spooktacular combat you know and love from HorrorVale

  • Hunt down Bounty after Bounty as you push back the Creepy menace!

  • Solve puzzles, fight monsters, and explore locations never before seen in HorrorVale!

Story

  • Embark on a thrilling adventure spanning 4 Chapters!

  • Experience the story of HorrorVale in a brand new light from the perspective of Mothman

  • See the events that lead up to HorrorVale, as well as what happens afterwards!

Characters

  • Recruit over 9 mysterious Cryptids to your crew, each with their own unique abilities!

  • Experience unique and personalized dialogue depending on the characters you bring with you!

  • Combine character abilities into special team attacks! 

NOTE: It is extremely recommend to play "HorrorVale" prior to experiencing HorrorVale: Act M!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft® Windows® 10 / 11 (32-bit/64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Pentium® 4 2.0 GHz equivalent or faster processor
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 1024 x 768 pixels or higher desktop resolution
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Join the legendary Bounty Hunter in this "Side B"... Or perhaps "Side M" of the HorrorVale storyline. Help Mothman fend off the Creepy menace as he comes to terms with the demons tormenting him.
